items.stemEn: Soup made with vegetables and beans is cheap and ____.

items.stemEn: After years in a small village, she ____ for life in a big city.
items.stemZh: 在小村子住了好幾年後，她渴望大城市的生活。

items.passageEn: Mr. Evans runs a small restaurant by the sea. His most popular dish is fried cod with mashed potatoes and gravy. Some customers say the fried fish is too oily, so he now offers grilled cod too. For dessert, he serves fresh pineapple, and there is a jug of cold water on every table. Last year, he hired two part-time cooks because he was too busy. He wants all his food to be tasty and nutritious.
items.passageZh: Evans 先生在海邊開了一家小餐廳。他最受歡迎的菜是炸鱈魚配馬鈴薯泥和肉汁。有些客人說炸魚太油了，所以他現在也提供烤鱈魚。甜點是新鮮鳳梨，每張桌上都有一壺冷水。去年，他因為太忙而雇用了兩位兼職廚師。他希望他所有的菜都既好吃又有營養。

questions.questionZh: Evans 先生為什麼現在也提供烤鱈魚？
去年 Evans 先生為什麼雇用兩位廚師？
